title: Customs and Shipping Document Extraction
summary: Extract and cross-check data from commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, airway bills and certificates of origin, and prepare checked job data for bill of entry or shipping bill filing.

seo.title: Customs and Shipping Document Extraction AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that extracts data from invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and airway bills, cross-checks them and prepares job data for customs filing.

problem.intro: Every import or export job brings a set of documents from shippers, consignees and carriers: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or airway bill, certificate of origin, insurance certificate and sometimes licences or test reports. Documentation executives at customs brokers and forwarders key the same data into their operating system and the customs filing, then check documents against each other by eye.

pain_points.title: Re-keying from many layouts
pain_points.detail: Each supplier's invoice and each carrier's bill of lading looks different, so templates break and data is typed by hand.

pain_points.title: Inconsistencies across documents
pain_points.detail: Quantities, weights, container numbers, Incoterms and consignee details that differ between invoice, packing list and BL lead to queries and amendments.

pain_points.title: Classification and valuation risk
pain_points.detail: Goods descriptions too vague to support the declared HS code, or invoice values that do not add up, attract customs queries.

pain_points.title: Deadline pressure
pain_points.detail: Filing delays add demurrage and detention, so documentation teams work under constant pressure around vessel cut-offs and arrivals.

solution.overview: We build a document pipeline for customs brokers, forwarders and EXIM teams. Each job's documents are classified and key fields extracted: parties, invoice lines with description, quantity, unit price and value, HS codes where stated, Incoterms, container and seal numbers, weights, ports and dates. The system cross-checks documents against each other and the job record, recalculates invoice totals, and flags vague descriptions or missing documents. A documentation executive reviews the checked data on one screen before it goes to your operating system or filing software. Classification and valuation decisions stay with your licensed customs broker.
capabilities: Classifies job documents: commercial invoice, packing list, BL, AWB, certificate of origin and insurance
Extracts parties, invoice lines, values, Incoterms, containers, seals, weights, ports and dates
Cross-checks quantities, weights and parties across invoice, packing list and transport document
Recalculates invoice line totals and currency values
Flags vague goods descriptions and documents missing for the job type
Exports checked data to your forwarding or customs filing software

workflow.title: Collect job documents
workflow.detail: Documents arrive by email or customer portal and are grouped by job or shipment reference.

workflow.title: Classify and extract
workflow.detail: Each document is classified and its fields extracted with source references.

workflow.title: Cross-check
workflow.detail: Values are compared across documents and with the booking or job record, and totals are recalculated.

workflow.title: Flag issues
workflow.detail: Mismatches, vague descriptions and missing documents are listed with the documents involved.

workflow.title: Executive review
workflow.detail: The documentation executive confirms the data, resolves flags with the customer and approves the job.

workflow.title: Export for filing
workflow.detail: Approved data goes to the forwarding system or filing software for bill of entry or shipping bill preparation.

inputs: Bills of lading, sea waybills and airway bills
Certificates of origin and insurance certificates
Booking or job details from the forwarding system
Customer product master with past descriptions and HS codes where available
outputs: Structured job data with source links
Data export for bill of entry or shipping bill preparation
Audit trail of edits and approvals
human_in_the_loop: Documentation executives approve all job data before export and resolve mismatches with the shipper or consignee. HS classification, valuation and filing decisions remain with your licensed customs broker.
integrations: Freight forwarding or customs brokerage software (via API or file import)
ICEGATE filing through your existing filing software
ERP for importer or exporter master data
guardrails: The system never sets a final HS code; any suggestion is labelled for the broker to decide
Every field linked to its source document and page
Extraction schema changes versioned and tested
compliance_notes: Supports accurate declarations under the Customs Act 1962 by checking consistency between commercial and transport documents before filing.
Customer commercial data is kept confidential and processed in your chosen cloud region.

pilot.scope: One trade lane or customer group, for imports or exports, using recently filed jobs plus a live parallel run.
deliverables: Field schemas for the pilot document types
Accuracy report against filed job data

what_we_measure.how: Extracted values compared with the data in filed jobs for the same documents.
Flags the documentation executive confirms as genuine discrepancies.
Time to prepare job data with and without the pipeline on comparable jobs.
Post-filing amendments needed on pilot jobs, tracked with their reasons.

faqs.q: Can the system classify goods under HS codes?
faqs.a: It can suggest candidate codes from descriptions and your past classifications for a broker to consider, but it does not decide classification. Final HS codes and valuation stay with your licensed customs broker.
Digital PDFs, scans, photos and Excel packing lists. Documents in other languages from your regular trading partners can be tested during the pilot.

faqs.q: Does it file directly on ICEGATE?
faqs.a: No. It exports checked data to the filing software your team already uses, which handles submission.

faqs.q: Can it work for EU or other customs regimes?
faqs.a: Yes. Extraction and cross-checks work the same way, and the export format is mapped to the target system. Regime-specific rules are configured with your team.
